name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate

entry.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate
entry.note: The AWS machine learning credential still on offer after the Machine Learning Specialty was retired in March 2026
entry.audience: ML engineers and MLOps practitioners building on AWS

covers: Generative AI implementation (Amazon Bedrock, RAG architectures)
Agentic AI (orchestrating AI agents and complex workflows)
Foundation models and LLMs (selection, fine-tuning, operationalization)
Responsible AI practices across traditional ML and GenAI
reading.format: 85 questions; multiple choice and multiple response. 65 questions; multiple choice and multiple response. Pearson VUE testing center or online proctored exam.
reading.status: The current exam (MLA-C01) in English is available through September 28, 2026. MLA-C01 in Korean, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese remains available until general availability of MLA-C02. Registration for the updated exam (MLA-C02) beta opens September 1, 2026, and beta delivery begins September 29, 2026. The beta is available in English only.
reading.summary: This is an AWS certification that validates technical ability in implementing machine learning workloads in production and operationalizing them. It is intended to support career credibility and position holders for machine learning job roles. The updated exam reflects a broadened scope of the ML engineer role.
reading.audience: The ideal candidate has at least 1 year of experience in machine learning engineering or a related field and 1 year of hands-on experience with AWS services. People without prior machine learning experience can use the training in the Exam Prep Plans to build their knowledge and skills.
reading.validity: Your certification remains active through its full validity period regardless of when you earn it.
reading.prerequisites: At least 1 year of experience in machine learning engineering or a related field and 1 year of hands-on experience with AWS services.
